description:
Step into the world of trading cards and build the ultimate collector’s haven! As the proud owner of a TCG shop, you’ll stock shelves with the latest packs, price rare finds, and grow your store into a bustling empire. Will you focus on flipping high-value cards for profit, or create a welcoming space for dedicated players and collectors?

Expand your business by hosting tournaments, hiring the right staff, and making strategic upgrades to attract loyal customers. Every decision shapes your store’s future—buy, trade, and sell your way to the top. Whether you're a card game veteran or just love the thrill of the trade, the path to TCG greatness starts here!
name: Trade Em Up: TCG Empire Shop
intro: From booster packs to business stacks—build the ultimate card shop empire!
